goal: Dense-cluster CLEARANCE: 6 cubes in a tight cluster, the centre cube fully surrounded. The jaw can't extract the centre selectively (fundamental side-clearance limit), so de-cluster: pick the EXPOSED neighbours first (source order edges->centre), each removal exposing more, until the centre is reachable. Tests whether sequenced clearance handles a dense cluster the centre-pick alone failed on.
code:
create_scene_baseline(include_ground=False, table_size=[2.0, 1.0])

robot_wizard(robot_name="franka_panda", dest_path="/World/Franka", position=[0, 0, 0.75], orientation=[0.7071068, 0, 0, 0.7071068])

for _spec in (("red",0.36,0.18),("green",0.48,0.18),("cyan",0.42,0.13),("blue",0.39,0.23),("yellow",0.45,0.23),("magenta",0.42,0.18)):
    _n,_x,_y=_spec
    create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_"+_n, prim_type="Cube", position=[_x,_y,0.83], size=0.05)
    for _api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI","PhysicsCollisionAPI","PhysicsMassAPI"):
        apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_"+_n, schema_name=_api)

create_bin(prim_path="/World/Bin", position=[0.0, -0.45, 0.75], size=[0.3, 0.3, 0.15])

setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    robot_family="franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_red","/World/Cube_green","/World/Cube_blue","/World/Cube_yellow","/World/Cube_cyan","/World/Cube_magenta"],
    destination_path="/World/Bin",
    task="declutter",
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Table"],
)
